title: The Manon Cap Ladder

title: Signature Throttle Curve
description: Manon's throttle is not a flat gap but a curve: generation starts slow, may accelerate as verification confidence grows, and snaps back to slow at the first failure. The demo shows the gap shrinking across clean runs and resetting on a fault.

title: Signature Weed Protocol

title: Sim-Label Plus
description: Manon's labeling goes beyond 'simulated': each record also carries the generator's version, the check name that passed it, and a content hash. If two records ever collide on hash, the second is quarantined. Labels become fingerprints, not stickers.

title: Fine-Tune Spiral
description: Where the public loop tightens a threshold, Manon's spiral also widens the test set each pass: stricter checks against harder cases, so quality climbs while coverage grows. The demo runs two spiral passes and confirms both stricter acceptance and a larger probe set.
reference_implementation_js: spiral(pass): threshold up, probe set larger

demo.code:
class SigReg:
    "Self-regulating generator wrapper: hard cap, throttle, correctness gate, simulated labeling."
    HARD_CAP_DEFAULT = 1000000000000
    def __init__(self, max_records=1000000000000, min_gap_s=0.0, cost_per=1, budget=float("inf"), check=None):
        self.cap = max_records; self.min_gap = min_gap_s; self.cost = cost_per; self.budget = budget
        self.check = check or (lambda item: (True, []))
        self.produced = 0; self.spent = 0; self._last = 0.0; self.log = []
    def generate(self, seed, producer):
        import time
        if self.produced >= self.cap:
            raise RuntimeError("HARD_CAP_REACHED at %d records" % self.cap)
        now = time.monotonic()
        if self.min_gap > 0 and self._last > 0 and (now - self._last) < self.min_gap:
            raise RuntimeError("THROTTLE: %.3fs remaining" % (self.min_gap - (now - self._last)))
        self._last = now
        item = producer(seed)
        ok, errs = self.check(item)
        if not ok:
            raise RuntimeError("CORRECTNESS_FAILED: " + "; ".join(errs))
        item["_label"] = "simulated"; item["_seq"] = self.produced + 1
        item["_sigreg"] = {"hard_cap": self.cap, "seq": self.produced + 1, "verified": True}
        self.produced += 1; self.spent += self.cost
        if self.spent > self.budget:
            raise RuntimeError("BUDGET_EXCEEDED")
        self.log.append({"seq": self.produced, "seed": seed, "t": now})
        return item

probes1 = [{"id": "p%d" % i, "score": i * 10} for i in range(1, 11)]
probes2 = probes1 + [{"id": "q%d" % i, "score": i * 7} for i in range(1, 11)]
keep1 = [r for r in probes1 if r["score"] >= 50]
keep2 = [r for r in probes2 if r["score"] >= 80]
assert len(keep2) < len(keep1), "stricter second pass"
assert len(probes2) > len(probes1), "wider probe set"
print("spiral: pass1 kept %d/%d, pass2 kept %d/%d" % (len(keep1), len(probes1), len(keep2), len(probes2)))

title: The Million Fill March
description: Manon's standing order made executable: the fill march stamps every database file with its march marker and refuses to file a batch unless the marker, the count, and the verification all agree. The demo files a 300-record batch only after all three checks pass.

title: Harness Prime
description: Manon's prime harness seeds the generator with adversarial cases first — the nastiest inputs run before the easy ones — so a weak check fails fast instead of after a thousand clean records. The demo orders adversarial seeds first and confirms early failure.

title: Host Guard Signature
description: Beyond the budget ledger, Manon's host guard watches generation rate: if records-per-second exceed a ceiling the wrapper sleeps the excess off instead of merely counting cost. Money and heat are both guarded. The demo enforces a 1000-records-per-tick ceiling.

title: The Provenance Seal
description: Manon's seal chains provenance: each record's seal includes the hash of the previous record's seal, forming a tamper-evident chain. Break one link and every later seal fails verification. The demo chains five records and detects a tamper.

title: Drift Radar
description: Manon's radar samples the live stream and compares its statistics against the archive's — mean record size, field coverage, category mix. A stream that drifts from the archive's shape is flagged before it files anything. The demo flags a stream with shifted category mix.

title: The Suspicion Brake
description: Manon's brake is proportional: one failure slows generation, two failures halve the rate, three halt it. Unlike a binary breaker, the system degrades gracefully and recovers as clean records rebuild confidence. The demo walks the 1-2-3 sequence.

title: Canary Flight
description: Manon's canary flies in formation: three independent generator builds produce the same seed, and the batch ships only if all three agree record-for-record. One dissenter grounds the flight. The demo ships a unanimous batch and grounds a split one.

title: Ledger Stone
description: Manon's ledger is append-only and content-addressed: each entry's key is the hash of its contents, so rewriting history changes the keys and the fraud is visible. The demo shows an entry's key changing if its contents are edited.

title: The Regulator Scroll
description: Manon's scroll is the human-readable twin of the machine report: one page per cycle, plain sentences stating what was generated, what was weeded, and what was filed. If the scroll cannot be written in plain language, the cycle does not count as regulated.
